arguments.command:
cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); gh pr merge 41 --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit aef32620688d5e9f5ebe73a3e69d94c78a5a106c --subject "feat: stop installing git hooks in the target repository (#41)" --body "pi-action no longer installs commit-msg or prepare-commit-msg hooks in the
target repository. pi follows the repository's own conventions: its git
hooks, AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.

- Remove the hooks step from action.yml and delete
  scripts/install-agent-hooks.js; keep this repository's own
  prepare-commit-msg hook and move its tests.
- Test that action.yml runs only src/index.ts and src/push.ts and installs
  no hooks, and that a run with core.hooksPath set leaves hooks and the
  commit message untouched.
- Document the commit conventions and add AGENTS.md.
- Add a commitlint CI job for pull requests.

Closes #38" 2>&1; gh pr view 41 --json state,mergeCommit --jq '{state,sha:.mergeCommit.oid}'; git checkout -q main && git pull -q && git log --oneline -2
